[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 5: Naming Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]5.1[/color] Don't make meta references. Try to be creative by picking a believable and fitting name within the game's lore. ★
[color=#a4885c]5.2[/color] Ship names, particularly those of Command roles, must be appropriate and consistent with the sector's lore and the owner's character. Low roleplay names, direct meta references, and names unrelated to the setting are prohibited. Examples include naming the Overseer's Ravager "Goober", "Meow Meow Meow", or similarly inappropriate names. ★
